 * ReplicaForge translation template.
 *
 * This file exists so translators have the full string list. It is not loaded at

 * Copy this file to `replicaforge-{locale}.po` — for example

 *
 * Regenerate the string list with WP-CLI when the plugin changes:
 *
 *     wp i18n make-pot . languages/replicaforge.pot
 *
 * @package ReplicaForge
